title: Sponsorship Prospectus Now Available
description: Archived sponsorship prospectus announcement and sponsorship options for the Vancouver 2015 OpenStack Summit.
body:
Having a presence at the OpenStack Summit is a great way to get your company in front of the OpenStack community. Read about the various options in the Sponsorship Prospectus and check out how to become a sponsor.

  • Sponsorship Prospectus (PDF File)

archiveNotice: Archived event content. Dates, registration information and policies below apply to this historical Summit.
